answer_1.quote: Recent data-to-text generation studies have shown significant improvement in generating faithful text aligned with data sources.

answer_2.quote: We used BLEU, ROUGE-L, and METEOR to evaluate the informativeness of generated texts. We computed the BERTSCORE to assess the similarity between the generated texts and the ground-truth table descriptions ... We also used the PARENT metric ...

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation ... to better assess the quality of the generated text. ... We elicited judgments with Amazon Mechanical Turk ...
answer_4.guideline: Raters counted supported/contradicted facts and rated relevance; used best-worst scaling for fluency categories.
